texture_slots.description: Shader Resource Views (SRV) for textures and buffers
texture_slots.ue5_convention: Textures bound starting at t0, incrementing per resource

uav_slots.description: Unordered Access Views (UAV) for read-write resources
uav_slots.ue5_convention: RW resources bound starting at u0, incrementing per resource

sampler_slots.ue5_convention: Samplers bound starting at s0, shared across materials

cbuffer_slots.ue5_convention: View uniforms at b0, material parameters at b1+

binding_best_practices: Always specify explicit register bindings in UE5 shaders
Use KAIN @N syntax which maps to register(tN) for textures
Avoid binding conflicts by checking existing slot usage
Group related resources in adjacent slots for better cache locality
Use permutations (CFG_*) to conditionally bind expensive resources

ue5_specific.global_shaders: Use SHADER_PARAMETER macros for automatic binding
